hookRows.notes: Owner-approved empty-house V3 M3 ruler-method row. Method, not portrait.
hookRows.body_you: You grow through other people: introductions, partnerships, the fair deal that leads to three more. Your chances multiply when both sides win.
hookRows.body_they: They grow through other people: introductions, partnerships, the fair deal that leads to three more. Their chances multiply when both sides win.

hookRows.notes: Owner-approved empty-house V3 M3 ruler-method row. Method, not portrait.
hookRows.body_you: You grow by giving the intangible its space: imagination, compassion, faith that does not need proof. The gains are real but rarely arrive on schedule or in cash.
hookRows.body_they: They grow by giving the intangible its space: imagination, compassion, faith that does not need proof. The gains are real but rarely arrive on schedule or in cash.

hookRows.notes: Owner-approved empty-house V3 M3 ruler-method row. Method, not portrait.
hookRows.body_you: You grow by range: travel, study, belief tested against the world, and the bet on meaning over comfort. Faith in the destination is your fuel and your risk.
hookRows.body_they: They grow by range: travel, study, belief tested against the world, and the bet on meaning over comfort. Faith in the destination is their fuel and their risk.

hookRows.notes: Owner-approved empty-house V3 M3 ruler-method row. Method, not portrait.
hookRows.body_you: You grow through depth: shared resources, real intimacy, the opportunity hidden where others will not look. Suspicion of the catch is the brake worth watching.
hookRows.body_they: They grow through depth: shared resources, real intimacy, the opportunity hidden where others will not look. Suspicion of the catch is the brake worth watching.

hookRows.notes: Owner-approved empty-house V3 M3 ruler-method row. Method, not portrait.
hookRows.body_you: You grow by accumulation: resources, skills, and comforts built patiently until they hold on their own. Opportunity here is rarely a windfall; it is slow, layered gains.
hookRows.body_they: They grow by accumulation: resources, skills, and comforts built patiently until they hold on their own. Opportunity here is rarely a windfall; it is slow, layered gains.

hookRows.notes: Owner-approved empty-house V3 M3 ruler-method row. Method, not portrait.
hookRows.body_you: You grow by improving what already exists: refine it, test it, make it useful, and the payoff follows. The ceiling is expanding the fine print instead of the point.
hookRows.body_they: They grow by improving what already exists: refine it, test it, make it useful, and the payoff follows. The ceiling is expanding the fine print instead of the point.

hookRows.notes: Owner-approved empty-house V3 M3 ruler-method row. Method, not portrait.
hookRows.body_you: You act on the principle and the plan, most freely when nobody is standing over you. Direct orders slow you down; a reason speeds you up.
hookRows.body_they: They act on the principle and the plan, most freely when nobody is standing over them. Direct orders slow them down; a reason speeds them up.

hookRows.notes: Owner-approved empty-house V3 M3 ruler-method row. Method, not portrait.
hookRows.body_you: You act immediately or not at all, and momentum is your best tool. Anger comes fast, burns clean, and is gone before most people finish reacting.
hookRows.body_they: They act immediately or not at all, and momentum is their best tool. Anger comes fast, burns clean, and is gone before most people finish reacting.

hookRows.notes: Owner-approved empty-house V3 M3 ruler-method row. Method, not portrait.
hookRows.body_you: You act for and around: protecting your own directly, pursuing your goals sideways. Your force shows up strongest when someone you love is on the line.
hookRows.body_they: They act for and around: protecting their own directly, pursuing their goals sideways. Their force shows up strongest when someone they love is on the line.

hookRows.notes: Owner-approved empty-house V3 M3 ruler-method row. Method, not portrait.
hookRows.body_you: You work in campaigns: staged effort, conserved force, the goal chosen before the first step. You almost never act on impulse, and you rarely quit.
hookRows.body_they: They work in campaigns: staged effort, conserved force, the goal chosen before the first step. They almost never act on impulse, and they rarely quit.

hookRows.notes: Owner-approved empty-house V3 M3 ruler-method row. Method, not portrait.
hookRows.body_you: You act on several fronts at once, and words are your first move. The risk is winning the exchange and abandoning the follow-through.
hookRows.body_they: They act on several fronts at once, and words are their first move. The risk is winning the exchange and abandoning the follow-through.

hookRows.notes: Owner-approved empty-house V3 M3 ruler-method row. Method, not portrait.
hookRows.body_you: You act in full view and put your name on the swing. Effort feels pointless without an audience or a cause worth the display.
hookRows.body_they: They act in full view and put their name on the swing. Effort feels pointless without an audience or a cause worth the display.

hookRows.notes: Owner-approved empty-house V3 M3 ruler-method row. Method, not portrait.
hookRows.body_you: You push through position and alliance: the well-timed proposal, the united front, the fight framed as fairness. Open aggression is your last resort, not your first.
hookRows.body_they: They push through position and alliance: the well-timed proposal, the united front, the fight framed as fairness. Open aggression is their last resort, not their first.

hookRows.notes: Owner-approved empty-house V3 M3 ruler-method row. Method, not portrait.
hookRows.body_you: You advance by current rather than collision: rhythm, atmosphere, the opening instead of the obstacle. Your effort doubles when the goal helps someone beyond you.
hookRows.body_they: They advance by current rather than collision: rhythm, atmosphere, the opening instead of the obstacle. Their effort doubles when the goal helps someone beyond them.

hookRows.notes: Owner-approved empty-house V3 M3 ruler-method row. Method, not portrait.
hookRows.body_you: You charge at the big target and skip the small ones, and subtlety has never been your instrument. Conviction moves you; maintenance stalls you.
hookRows.body_they: They charge at the big target and skip the small ones, and subtlety has never been their instrument. Conviction moves them; maintenance stalls them.

hookRows.notes: Owner-approved empty-house V3 M3 ruler-method row. Method, not portrait.
hookRows.body_you: You move under the surface: strategy first, patience second, the decisive act only when it counts. You hold your cards close and rarely show effort before results.
hookRows.body_they: They move under the surface: strategy first, patience second, the decisive act only when it counts. They hold their cards close and rarely show effort before results.

hookRows.notes: Owner-approved empty-house V3 M3 ruler-method row. Method, not portrait.
hookRows.body_you: You move late and heavy: slow to start, nearly impossible to stop once rolling. Pushed before you are ready, you do not fight; you simply do not move.
hookRows.body_they: They move late and heavy: slow to start, nearly impossible to stop once rolling. Pushed before they are ready, they do not fight; they simply do not move.

hookRows.notes: Owner-approved empty-house V3 M3 ruler-method row. Method, not portrait.
hookRows.body_you: You work through the list: precise, prepared, effective in the details others skip. The trap is polishing the plan instead of executing it.
hookRows.body_they: They work through the list: precise, prepared, effective in the details others skip. The trap is polishing the plan instead of executing it.

hookRows.notes: Owner-approved empty-house V3 M3 ruler-method row. Method, not portrait.
hookRows.body_you: You reason from the principle, question what everyone else assumed, and land on positions years early. Consensus arrives later; you rarely wait for it.
hookRows.body_they: They reason from the principle, question what everyone else assumed, and land on positions years early. Consensus arrives later; they rarely wait for it.

hookRows.notes: Owner-approved empty-house V3 M3 ruler-method row. Method, not portrait.
hookRows.body_you: You decide fast and sharpen your position by defending it. Your first take is often right about direction and rough on detail.
hookRows.body_they: They decide fast and sharpen their position by defending it. Their first take is often right about direction and rough on detail.

hookRows.notes: Owner-approved empty-house V3 M3 ruler-method row. Method, not portrait.
hookRows.body_you: You decide by feel first and check the logic after, and you read tone more accurately than content. How a message is delivered can matter to you more than its facts.
hookRows.body_they: They decide by feel first and check the logic after, and they read tone more accurately than content. How a message is delivered can matter to them more than its facts.

hookRows.notes: Owner-approved empty-house V3 M3 ruler-method row. Method, not portrait.
hookRows.body_you: You decide on evidence and consequence: what it costs, what it builds, how it looks in a year. Slow to answer, hard to reverse.
hookRows.body_they: They decide on evidence and consequence: what it costs, what it builds, how it looks in a year. Slow to answer, hard to reverse.

hookRows.notes: Owner-approved empty-house V3 M3 ruler-method row. Method, not portrait.
hookRows.body_you: You think by connecting: two sources, three conversations, and the answer assembles itself mid-sentence. The risk is collecting options instead of choosing one.
hookRows.body_they: They think by connecting: two sources, three conversations, and the answer assembles itself mid-sentence. The risk is collecting options instead of choosing one.

hookRows.notes: Owner-approved empty-house V3 M3 ruler-method row. Method, not portrait.
hookRows.body_you: You think in conclusions and deliver them with confidence, and you argue best for what you personally believe. Being ignored bothers you more than a challenge does.
hookRows.body_they: They think in conclusions and deliver them with confidence, and they argue best for what they personally believe. Being ignored bothers them more than a challenge does.

hookRows.notes: Owner-approved empty-house V3 M3 ruler-method row. Method, not portrait.
hookRows.body_you: You think in comparisons and rarely commit before hearing the other side. That keeps you fair, and it can turn a simple yes into a week of weighing.
hookRows.body_they: They think in comparisons and rarely commit before hearing the other side. That keeps them fair, and it can turn a simple yes into a week of weighing.

hookRows.notes: Owner-approved empty-house V3 M3 ruler-method row. Method, not portrait.
hookRows.body_you: You follow a hunch to the answer and build the reasoning on the way back. Exact figures and firm dates hold badly when the mood around you is heavy.
hookRows.body_they: They follow a hunch to the answer and build the reasoning on the way back. Exact figures and firm dates hold badly when the mood around them is heavy.

hookRows.notes: Owner-approved empty-house V3 M3 ruler-method row. Method, not portrait.
hookRows.body_you: You think big first and check the details later, and you are more interested in what it means than how it works. Your best decisions have a direction, not a spreadsheet.
hookRows.body_they: They think big first and check the details later, and they are more interested in what it means than how it works. Their best decisions have a direction, not a spreadsheet.

hookRows.notes: Owner-approved empty-house V3 M3 ruler-method row. Method, not portrait.
hookRows.body_you: You investigate more than you converse: you say little, watch closely, and draw conclusions you rarely announce. When you finally speak, the case is already built.
hookRows.body_they: They investigate more than they converse: they say little, watch closely, and draw conclusions they rarely announce. When they finally speak, the case is already built.

hookRows.notes: Owner-approved empty-house V3 M3 ruler-method row. Method, not portrait.
hookRows.body_you: You think slowly and hold conclusions: you would rather be sure than be first. Once your mind is made, new arguments need real evidence to move it.
hookRows.body_they: They think slowly and hold conclusions: they would rather be sure than be first. Once their mind is made, new arguments need real evidence to move it.

hookRows.notes: Owner-approved empty-house V3 M3 ruler-method row. Method, not portrait.
hookRows.body_you: You decide by narrowing: gather, sort, cut what fails, keep what works. It is precise and reliable, and it can stall at the last five percent.
hookRows.body_they: They decide by narrowing: gather, sort, cut what fails, keep what works. It is precise and reliable, and it can stall at the last five percent.

hookRows.notes: Owner-approved empty-house V3 M3 ruler-method row. Method, not portrait.
hookRows.body_you: You process feeling at a distance: name it, think it over, come back when it is sorted. Space is not coldness for you; it is how the sorting gets done.
hookRows.body_they: They process feeling at a distance: name it, think it over, come back when it is sorted. Space is not coldness for them; it is how the sorting gets done.

hookRows.notes: Owner-approved empty-house V3 M3 ruler-method row. Method, not portrait.
hookRows.body_you: You settle by acting: a fast reaction, a direct answer, and the mood clears as quickly as it came. What throws you most is having to wait.
hookRows.body_they: They settle by acting: a fast reaction, a direct answer, and the mood clears as quickly as it came. What throws them most is having to wait.

hookRows.notes: Owner-approved empty-house V3 M3 ruler-method row. Method, not portrait.
hookRows.body_you: You protect what matters by keeping it close: familiar people, a known place, a door you can shut. When overwhelmed you withdraw first and explain later.
hookRows.body_they: They protect what matters by keeping it close: familiar people, a known place, a door they can shut. When overwhelmed they withdraw first and explain later.

hookRows.notes: Owner-approved empty-house V3 M3 ruler-method row. Method, not portrait.
hookRows.body_you: You contain feeling by taking care of business: solve the practical problem first and the emotion follows. The cost of postponed rest still arrives eventually.
hookRows.body_they: They contain feeling by taking care of business: solve the practical problem first and the emotion follows. The cost of postponed rest still arrives eventually.

hookRows.notes: Owner-approved empty-house V3 M3 ruler-method row. Method, not portrait.
hookRows.body_you: You process feeling by talking it through, and a good conversation calms you faster than quiet does. Restlessness usually means a mood has not been put into words yet.
hookRows.body_they: They process feeling by talking it through, and a good conversation calms them faster than quiet does. Restlessness usually means a mood has not been put into words yet.

hookRows.notes: Owner-approved empty-house V3 M3 ruler-method row. Method, not portrait.
hookRows.body_you: You recover through warmth and being taken seriously: affection, attention, a little celebration. A private wobble often hides behind a confident face.
hookRows.body_they: They recover through warmth and being taken seriously: affection, attention, a little celebration. A private wobble often hides behind a confident face.

hookRows.notes: Owner-approved empty-house V3 M3 ruler-method row. Method, not portrait.
hookRows.body_you: You come back to yourself in company: talking with a partner or friend restores your balance faster than solitude. The cost is smoothing over a conflict that needed a direct answer.
hookRows.body_they: They come back to themselves in company: talking with a partner or friend restores their balance faster than solitude. The cost is smoothing over a conflict that needed a direct answer.

hookRows.notes: Owner-approved empty-house V3 M3 ruler-method row. Method, not portrait.
hookRows.body_you: You absorb the mood around you before you know it is not yours, so your state depends on the company you keep. Retreat is maintenance for you, not avoidance.
hookRows.body_they: They absorb the mood around them before they know it is not theirs, so their state depends on the company they keep. Retreat is maintenance for them, not avoidance.

hookRows.notes: Owner-approved empty-house V3 M3 ruler-method row. Method, not portrait.
hookRows.body_you: You need the exit to exist even if you never use it: the trip you could take, the backup plan, the bigger meaning behind a hard week. Pinned down, your mood flattens quietly before it ever turns loud.
hookRows.body_they: They need the exit to exist even if they never use it: the trip they could take, the backup plan, the bigger meaning behind a hard week. Pinned down, their mood flattens quietly before it ever turns loud.

hookRows.notes: Owner-approved empty-house V3 M3 ruler-method row. Method, not portrait.
hookRows.body_you: Your sense of security depends on certainty: you commit slowly, read what is not being said, and hold back until a person or plan has proven itself. Once it has, the loyalty is total.
hookRows.body_they: Their sense of security depends on certainty: they commit slowly, read what is not being said, and hold back until a person or plan has proven itself. Once it has, the loyalty is total.

hookRows.notes: Owner-approved empty-house V3 M3 ruler-method row. Method, not portrait.
hookRows.body_you: You settle through comfort and repetition: the same meal, the familiar chair, the plan that does not change. You shift slowly, and being rushed reads to you as a threat.
hookRows.body_they: They settle through comfort and repetition: the same meal, the familiar chair, the plan that does not change. They shift slowly, and being rushed reads to them as a threat.

hookRows.notes: Owner-approved empty-house V3 M3 ruler-method row. Method, not portrait.
hookRows.body_you: You calm yourself by fixing: sorting the list, clearing the desk, solving the small problem in reach. The risk is turning every feeling into a fault to correct.
hookRows.body_they: They calm themselves by fixing: sorting the list, clearing the desk, solving the small problem in reach. The risk is turning every feeling into a fault to correct.

hookRows.notes: Owner-approved empty-house V3 M3 ruler-method row. Method, not portrait.
hookRows.body_you: You build the better system: rules rewritten deliberately, communities structured to last, discipline in service of the future. Detachment is the risk that comes with the blueprint.
hookRows.body_they: They build the better system: rules rewritten deliberately, communities structured to last, discipline in service of the future. Detachment is the risk that comes with the blueprint.

hookRows.notes: Owner-approved empty-house V3 M3 ruler-method row. Method, not portrait.
hookRows.body_you: You build discipline directly onto impulse: the training plan, the cold start, initiative with a structure around it. Patience is not natural here; it is earned through repetition.
hookRows.body_they: They build discipline directly onto impulse: the training plan, the cold start, initiative with a structure around it. Patience is not natural here; it is earned through repetition.

hookRows.notes: Owner-approved empty-house V3 M3 ruler-method row. Method, not portrait.
hookRows.body_you: You build safety by hand: the reliable home, the dependable presence, the care you supply on schedule. The work is learning to give that same protection to yourself.
hookRows.body_they: They build safety by hand: the reliable home, the dependable presence, the care they supply on schedule. The work is learning to give that same protection to themselves.

hookRows.notes: Owner-approved empty-house V3 M3 ruler-method row. Method, not portrait.
hookRows.body_you: You are built for the long game and you know it: responsibility early, mastery late, every step load-bearing. Rest has to be scheduled or it does not happen.
hookRows.body_they: They are built for the long game and they know it: responsibility early, mastery late, every step load-bearing. Rest has to be scheduled or it does not happen.

hookRows.notes: Owner-approved empty-house V3 M3 ruler-method row. Method, not portrait.
hookRows.body_you: You structure your attention or lose it: notes, systems, one channel at a time. The fear of not being understood pushes you to over-explain before it teaches you precision.
hookRows.body_they: They structure their attention or lose it: notes, systems, one channel at a time. The fear of not being understood pushes them to over-explain before it teaches them precision.

hookRows.notes: Owner-approved empty-house V3 M3 ruler-method row. Method, not portrait.
hookRows.body_you: You earn confidence rather than assume it: skill built in private before the public claim. The fear of being unseen eases with each result that speaks for itself.
hookRows.body_they: They earn confidence rather than assume it: skill built in private before the public claim. The fear of being unseen eases with each result that speaks for itself.

hookRows.notes: Owner-approved empty-house V3 M3 ruler-method row. Method, not portrait.
hookRows.body_you: You build commitments that hold: clear terms, fair shares, promises with structure under them. The real work of partnership matters more to you than the comfort of keeping the peace.
hookRows.body_they: They build commitments that hold: clear terms, fair shares, promises with structure under them. The real work of partnership matters more to them than the comfort of keeping the peace.

hookRows.notes: Owner-approved empty-house V3 M3 ruler-method row. Method, not portrait.
hookRows.body_you: You give form to the formless: the practiced craft, the scheduled retreat, the dream with a deadline. No shortcuts survive here; the intangible only becomes real through repetition.
hookRows.body_they: They give form to the formless: the practiced craft, the scheduled retreat, the dream with a deadline. No shortcuts survive here; the intangible only becomes real through repetition.

hookRows.notes: Owner-approved empty-house V3 M3 ruler-method row. Method, not portrait.
hookRows.body_you: You put structure under belief: the studied conviction, the planned journey, freedom with a foundation. Discipline is what turns your vision from private daydream into itinerary.
hookRows.body_they: They put structure under belief: the studied conviction, the planned journey, freedom with a foundation. Discipline is what turns their vision from private daydream into itinerary.

hookRows.notes: Owner-approved empty-house V3 M3 ruler-method row. Method, not portrait.
hookRows.body_you: You build trust slowly and structurally: control examined, power made explicit, loyalty tested before it is granted. Facing what you fear losing is the actual curriculum.
hookRows.body_they: They build trust slowly and structurally: control examined, power made explicit, loyalty tested before it is granted. Facing what they fear losing is the actual curriculum.

hookRows.notes: Owner-approved empty-house V3 M3 ruler-method row. Method, not portrait.
hookRows.body_you: You build security in material layers: savings, skills, a body and a base you maintain. The lesson runs against rigidity: holding on is not the same as being safe.
hookRows.body_they: They build security in material layers: savings, skills, a body and a base they maintain. The lesson runs against rigidity: holding on is not the same as being safe.

hookRows.notes: Owner-approved empty-house V3 M3 ruler-method row. Method, not portrait.
hookRows.body_you: You build through exacting standards: tested routines, clean work, health treated as a discipline. Learning to accept good enough is the harder half of mastery.
hookRows.body_they: They build through exacting standards: tested routines, clean work, health treated as a discipline. Learning to accept good enough is the harder half of mastery.

hookRows.notes: Owner-approved empty-house V3 M3 ruler-method row. Method, not portrait.
hookRows.body_you: You steer by principle: the fair system, the long view, the improvement everyone benefits from. You do your best work at a slight distance from the crowd it serves.
hookRows.body_they: They steer by principle: the fair system, the long view, the improvement everyone benefits from. They do their best work at a slight distance from the crowd it serves.

hookRows.notes: Owner-approved empty-house V3 M3 ruler-method row. Method, not portrait.
hookRows.body_you: Your vitality depends on initiative: you are strongest at a beginning, acting on your own call. Waiting for permission drains you more than a wrong turn ever has.
hookRows.body_they: Their vitality depends on initiative: they are strongest at a beginning, acting on their own call. Waiting for permission drains them more than a wrong turn ever has.

hookRows.notes: Owner-approved empty-house V3 M3 ruler-method row. Method, not portrait.
hookRows.body_you: You lead from attachment: your effort follows the people and places you have decided are yours. Protecting what you love is the most reliable motive you have.
hookRows.body_they: They lead from attachment: their effort follows the people and places they have decided are theirs. Protecting what they love is the most reliable motive they have.

hookRows.notes: Owner-approved empty-house V3 M3 ruler-method row. Method, not portrait.
hookRows.body_you: You aim long and climb in order: each step has to earn the next. Respect matters more to you than applause, and you trust results over praise.
hookRows.body_they: They aim long and climb in order: each step has to earn the next. Respect matters more to them than applause, and they trust results over praise.

hookRows.notes: Owner-approved empty-house V3 M3 ruler-method row. Method, not portrait.
hookRows.body_you: Your direction stays alive through variety: two interests at once, questions asked early, plans that can change. Boredom is the warning that matters.
hookRows.body_they: Their direction stays alive through variety: two interests at once, questions asked early, plans that can change. Boredom is the warning that matters.

hookRows.notes: Owner-approved empty-house V3 M3 ruler-method row. Method, not portrait.
hookRows.body_you: Your energy rises when your work carries your name and someone sees it. Effort that stays invisible quietly stalls, no matter how good it is.
hookRows.body_they: Their energy rises when their work carries their name and someone sees it. Effort that stays invisible quietly stalls, no matter how good it is.

hookRows.notes: Owner-approved empty-house V3 M3 ruler-method row. Method, not portrait.
hookRows.body_you: Your sense of purpose sharpens in partnership: you weigh, compare, and decide better with a counterpart in the picture. Left alone too long, you postpone the call.
hookRows.body_they: Their sense of purpose sharpens in partnership: they weigh, compare, and decide better with a counterpart in the picture. Left alone too long, they postpone the call.

hookRows.notes: Owner-approved empty-house V3 M3 ruler-method row. Method, not portrait.
hookRows.body_you: Your direction arrives as a pull rather than a plan, and it strengthens when the work helps someone beyond you. Structure serves you; it just cannot lead.
hookRows.body_they: Their direction arrives as a pull rather than a plan, and it strengthens when the work helps someone beyond them. Structure serves them; it just cannot lead.

hookRows.notes: Owner-approved empty-house V3 M3 ruler-method row. Method, not portrait.
hookRows.body_you: Your effort needs a reason bigger than the task: a belief, a journey, a future worth the work. Routine holds only when it leads somewhere.
hookRows.body_they: Their effort needs a reason bigger than the task: a belief, a journey, a future worth the work. Routine holds only when it leads somewhere.

hookRows.notes: Owner-approved empty-house V3 M3 ruler-method row. Method, not portrait.
hookRows.body_you: You commit your will fully or not at all, and you prefer depth to display. Once a goal matters, you pursue it privately and completely.
hookRows.body_they: They commit their will fully or not at all, and they prefer depth to display. Once a goal matters, they pursue it privately and completely.

hookRows.notes: Owner-approved empty-house V3 M3 ruler-method row. Method, not portrait.
hookRows.body_you: You commit your energy slowly and stay with what you start. Comfort is not laziness for you; it is the base that makes long effort possible.
hookRows.body_they: They commit their energy slowly and stay with what they start. Comfort is not laziness for them; it is the base that makes long effort possible.

hookRows.notes: Owner-approved empty-house V3 M3 ruler-method row. Method, not portrait.
hookRows.body_you: You direct yourself through usefulness: improving what is in front of you, keeping the standard high. The risk is treating every flaw you find as yours to fix.
hookRows.body_they: They direct themselves through usefulness: improving what is in front of them, keeping the standard high. The risk is treating every flaw they find as theirs to fix.

hookRows.notes: Owner-approved empty-house V3 M3 ruler-method row. Method, not portrait.
hookRows.body_you: You value the unconventional fit: the friendship that ignores categories, the arrangement designed by its own participants. What everyone else wants has never been a reason.
hookRows.body_they: They value the unconventional fit: the friendship that ignores categories, the arrangement designed by its own participants. What everyone else wants has never been a reason.

hookRows.notes: Owner-approved empty-house V3 M3 ruler-method row. Method, not portrait.
hookRows.body_you: You know what you want immediately, and the chase is half the value. Desire here is honest and impatient; it fades fastest when everything is already settled.
hookRows.body_they: They know what they want immediately, and the chase is half the value. Desire here is honest and impatient; it fades fastest when everything is already settled.

hookRows.notes: Owner-approved empty-house V3 M3 ruler-method row. Method, not portrait.
hookRows.body_you: You value what has history and care in it, and you bond through feeding, hosting, and remembering. What you love, you keep; the risk is keeping it past its season.
hookRows.body_they: They value what has history and care in it, and they bond through feeding, hosting, and remembering. What they love, they keep; the risk is keeping it past its season.

hookRows.notes: Owner-approved empty-house V3 M3 ruler-method row. Method, not portrait.
hookRows.body_you: You invest rather than spend: in people, pleasures, and commitments that hold their worth over years. You show devotion through reliability and expect it back.
hookRows.body_they: They invest rather than spend: in people, pleasures, and commitments that hold their worth over years. They show devotion through reliability and expect it back.

hookRows.notes: Owner-approved empty-house V3 M3 ruler-method row. Method, not portrait.
hookRows.body_you: You value what keeps you interested: banter, variety, the option to change your mind. Charm comes easily; staying past the novelty is the practice.
hookRows.body_they: They value what keeps them interested: banter, variety, the option to change their mind. Charm comes easily; staying past the novelty is the practice.

hookRows.notes: Owner-approved empty-house V3 M3 ruler-method row. Method, not portrait.
hookRows.body_you: You value what you can be proud of: generous gestures, loyal people, a love that is not embarrassed of itself. Being taken for granted kills your interest faster than conflict ever will.
hookRows.body_they: They value what they can be proud of: generous gestures, loyal people, a love that is not embarrassed of itself. Being taken for granted kills their interest faster than conflict ever will.

hookRows.notes: Owner-approved empty-house V3 M3 ruler-method row. Method, not portrait.
hookRows.body_you: You choose by balance: what suits, what fits, what keeps matters even between the people involved. Your taste is exact; your no arrives late.
hookRows.body_they: They choose by balance: what suits, what fits, what keeps matters even between the people involved. Their taste is exact; their no arrives late.

hookRows.notes: Owner-approved empty-house V3 M3 ruler-method row. Method, not portrait.
hookRows.body_you: You value what softens the border a little: art, empathy, a connection that does not need explaining. Generosity comes first; the limit usually has to be learned.
hookRows.body_they: They value what softens the border a little: art, empathy, a connection that does not need explaining. Generosity comes first; the limit usually has to be learned.
